name: Introduction to Yoga and Neuroscience
description: Anatomy and physiology: introduction, human anatomy, neuroanatomy, systems, nervous system, human brain mapping, yogic anatomy, pancha koshas, asanas, impact of asanas on systems. Yogic physiology, prana, pranayama, yogic cleansing. Learning, memory and personality: perception, arousal, attention, emotion, learning, memory, language, thought, cognitive biases, yogic psychology, bahirkarana, antahkarana, samskaras and their formation, yama, niyama, pratyahara, dharana, shadripus, prana shuddhi, chitta shuddhi. Beyond personality: mirror neurons, neuroplasticity, yogic perspectives, dhyana, mindfulness and its effect on psychological well-being, samadhi, research methods, first-person neuroscience.
